name: Moto Guzzi 850 Le Mans
engine: 844 or 949 cc air-cooled transverse V-twin, two carbs, shaft drive
intro: Guzzi's classic sport twin. Big Dell'Orto carbs, linked brakes and a shaft drive.

K: The foot pedal works the rear and one front brake together. Bleed and check the system as a whole.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
